statusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // empty'); dir_name=$(basename "$dir" 2>/dev/null || echo "$dir"); repo=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.repo // empty'); git_info=""; if [ -n "$repo" ]; then branch=$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$branch" ]; then if git -C "$dir" diff-index --quiet HEAD -- 2>/dev/null; then state="+"; else state="~"; fi; git_info=" ${branch}${state}"; fi; fi; model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // empty'); model_str=""; if [ -n "$model" ]; then model_short=$(echo "$model" | sed 's/DeepSeek V4 Pro/DSv4/;s/Claude 3.5 Sonnet/C3.5/;s/Claude 3.7 Sonnet/C3.7/;s/Claude //'); model_str=" ${model_short}"; fi; used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); ctx_str=""; if [ -n "$used" ]; then used_int=$(printf "%.0f" "$used"); if [ "$used_int" -ge 80 ]; then ctx_str=" ctx:${used_int}%%"; fi; fi; printf "%s%s%s%s" "$dir_name" "$git_info" "$model_str" "$ctx_str"

hooks.command: python -c "import sys,json,os; inp=json.load(sys.stdin); fp=inp.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path','') or inp.get('tool_response',{}).get('filePath',''); targets=['PRD.md','TECH_DESING.md','backend/app/models/','backend/app/services/','backend/app/api/','frontend/src/pages/','frontend/src/stores/']; matched=any(t in fp.replace(chr(92),'/') for t in targets); claude_md=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(fp),'..','CLAUDE.md') if fp else ''; [sys.exit(0) if not matched else (print(json.dumps({'systemMessage':'CLAUDE.md may be stale. Run /init to refresh.'})), sys.exit(0))]" 2>/dev/null || true
